need.title: Community Garden Bed Wait List - Lottery Nov 2
need.details: Good Afternoon Beachwalk, If you are interested in a garden bed plot, please email Megan Heins at mheins@castlegroup.com. Our guidelines have been revised and have been attached for your review. We will be hosting a live lottery via zoom on Monday November 2nd at 1:00PM for those who are interested in a bed assignment. Please be advised that spots for the garden are limited. If you are interested please reach out to Megan no later than 9am on Monday November 2nd to add your name to the list. Thank you and have a wonderful day!

need.title: Election & Annual Meeting - Nov 4
need.details: The annual meeting and election will be held at 11am at the Elks Lodge in Englewood. Check-in begins at 10am. Please submit your proxy form to help reach quorum. If you are a multi-owner, bring voting certificates. This is an important meeting for community governance and board elections.

need.title: Lease Restrictions - 90 Day Minimum
need.details: The community has confirmed a minimum lease term of 90 days. Short-term rentals under 90 days are not permitted. Please ensure any lease agreements comply with this requirement. Contact the management company with questions about lease applications or restrictions.

need.title: Water Restriction Update
need.details: Southwest Florida Water Management District (SWFWMD) has issued water restrictions effective through March 31, 2027. Landscape replacements are limited during this period. Please follow all watering schedules and restrictions to avoid fines. Check the SWFWMD website or contact the HOA for specific guidelines.

need.title: Fourth Quarterly Assessments Due Oct 1
need.details: Fourth quarterly assessments are due October 1. Please check your account balance on beachwalkbymanasotakeyhoa.com. Contact Makenly Cooper at the management company if you have questions about your balance or payment options. Late fees may apply after the due date.

notices.title: High Tide Weekly Menu Available Today & Sunday 10.25
